Orianna

the Lady of Clockwork

Orianna fights by commanding a mechanical ball. She pokes with it, shields allies with it, and her ultimate pulls the whole enemy team into it. She's hard to master because you have to track two positions at once, but a great Orianna wins teamfights by herself.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Orianna

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. Her lane is safe and her poke is long-ranged, so she's rarely in a hopeless matchup.

Pick into

  • Teams that group up and dive, like Malphite, Yasuo and Diana: Shockwave pulls them together
  • Immobile scaling mages, like Cassiopeia and Ryze, she can poke safely
  • Front-to-back teamfight compositions where her ultimate decides fights
  • Teams that rely on one carry she can protect with Command: Protect

Avoid into

  • Assassins who dive her while the ball is away, like Ekko and LeBlanc
  • Long-range scaling mages who out-poke her, like Aurelion Sol
  • Split-push teams that never group up for her ultimate

Great teammates

MalphitePut the ball on Malphite with E, and his ultimate brings Shockwave right into the enemy team.
Jarvan IVJarvan dives in with the ball attached, then Orianna uses Shockwave.
YasuoShockwave knocks enemies into the air, which lets Yasuo use Last Breath.

Your team needs: Pick Orianna when your team has divers or tanks who can carry her ball into the enemy team.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • One of the best teamfight ultimates in the game
  • Safe, steady laning with long-range poke
  • Shields, armor and speed for her allies
  • Flexible: her ball can be wherever she needs it

Weaknesses

  • You have to track the ball's position all the time
  • Weak against assassins who dive her with the ball away
  • Low mobility: only W's speed and E's shield
  • Below average this patch (C tier) even after a small buff

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q + W poke is strong, and E gives you a shield.
  • Level 6: Shockwave makes every skirmish dangerous for the enemy.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): stronger poke and wave clear.
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): you can stand in fights long enough to land a big ultimate.

Top tips

  • Always know where your ball is. If you lose it, your next combo starts slowly.
  • Put the ball on your engage tank so your ultimate lands where they jump.
  • W speeds up allies: use it to help them chase or escape.
  • Shield yourself with E when an assassin dives you.
  • Weave auto-attacks between spells in lane. Your passive adds damage.
  • Don't use your ultimate on one target if you can wait for a group.
